title: We started on their hardest day. Day one.

items.value: We started on their hardest day. Day one.
Ashirwad Shukla, founder of Highmark Realty, beside the quote: No clients. No leads. No reputation.
A new channel partner firm. No client base, no lead flow, no track record to point at.

In Ahmedabad real estate that is a brutal position. Channel partners compete with established firms carrying years of builder relationships and referral pipelines. A new entrant has no referrals, so the only way in is to generate demand directly.
They needed leads before they had a reputation, and those leads had to convert, because a new firm cannot afford to burn budget learning.

title: Real estate marketing in Ahmedabad, corridor by corridor

items.value: Real estate marketing in Ahmedabad, corridor by corridor
Built the engine, not just the ads
Positioning, creative, campaign structure and lead capture designed as one system, so a lead is not handed to a page that undoes the ad.
Zundal, Vaishnodevi, Tragad, Chharodi, Gota, Shela, Shilaj and Jagatpur. Micro market by micro market, instead of one blanket Ahmedabad campaign.
Reels, ad videos and static creatives shot and edited by our own team. The work below is real material from this account.
The first campaign was the start of the process, not the end of it. That is why the lead flow has held instead of drying up.
Highmark's first campaign ran on two ad sets and one lead form. It reached 13,841 people and brought in 159 leads. More than 20 of them booked a flat. Below is the Ads Manager view of that campaign.
Meta Ads Manager · Highmark Realty · first campaign
Meta Ads Manager: two ad sets with 69 and 90 Meta leads, 159 in total, 13,841 reach, 40,225 impressions, CPM of ₹222.10
Meta Ads Manager: cost per link click of ₹9.35, link CTR of 2.38%, 1,437 clicks, overall CTR of 3.57%
Two ad sets, side by side
One got cheaper clicks, ₹7.94 each at a 2.85% link CTR. The other paid ₹11.03 a click and still brought in 90 of the 159 leads. We judged both on leads, not clicks, so both kept running.
People filled in the lead form without leaving Instagram or Facebook. A few questions on it sorted serious buyers from the curious before Highmark's team picked up the phone.
Show the flat in the ad
Floor plan, price and a walkthrough, all in the ad itself. Overall CTR landed at 3.57%, at ₹222 per thousand impressions.
Repeat it for the next launch
What worked here became the starting point for later projects in Zundal, Vaishnodevi, Chharodi and Gota.

The first project campaign put Highmark on the map, and the ones after it have taken the count past 5,000 qualified leads. For a brand new firm, that first campaign bought something more useful than revenue. It bought proof, to builders and to buyers, that Highmark could move inventory.

What matters more is what came after. The lead flow has held for campaign after campaign, so this was never one lucky month. On the back of it Highmark grew from a standing start to a team of ten, serving over 1,000 regular clients across Ahmedabad.
Do you run Meta ads for real estate in Ahmedabad?
Yes. We work corridor by corridor across areas like Zundal, Gota, Shela, Shilaj, Tragad, Chharodi, Vaishnodevi and Jagatpur, rather than running one campaign for the whole city.
How quickly do leads start coming in?

Leads usually start within the first days of a campaign going live. The number worth watching is not day one volume, it is how many of those leads your team can actually reach and qualify in the first week.
How do you stop the sales team wasting hours on junk leads?
We qualify at the form instead of after the call. Budget bracket and intent are captured before the lead reaches your team, so the hours go to buyers who can actually transact.
Do you produce the ad creative, or do we supply it?
We produce it. Reels, ad videos and static creatives are all shot and edited in-house.
